name: amityai-lbm-v0.1
note: Amity AI Holdings Co.,Ltd. One relational foundation model with a history encoder and column writer. Schema-driven automatic input; per-task fine-tuning on the train split for some tasks (in-context: no). Rule 1: every input row strictly before each row's seed time (fail-closed canaries); train and val labels only; all model choices by validation. rel-f1 uses get_db(upto_test_timestamp=False) with per-row censoring. Disclosure: rel-f1/driver-top3 was scored twice. The first read used the default frozen DB by a pipeline omission (0.561). This entry is the second read, with the full-DB regime fixed before any test read. All other tasks were scored once. This entry covers the classification board; we intend to submit the regression and recommendation boards with a later release of the same model.
